name: comp-268
blurb: Bordered warning alert with amber icon.
description: Warning alert with visible border, displayed inline. Uses amber warning icon and plain text message. Designed as a more visually prominent alternative to comp-267.
use_when: Showing warnings that need visual separation from surrounding content via a border. Good for form sections or grouped information.
avoid_when: When a minimal inline style is preferred. Dense layouts with multiple alerts.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden from screen readers. Parent must add role='alert' and aria-live for screen reader announcements.
